name: RecordAgentFeedback
description: Stores structured feedback on a receipts agent from the receipts panel, with no agent reply: "נקרא נכון / טעות בקריאה" on a reader line, "נינה צדקה / טעתה" on a checked line, and file comments (verdict הערה). A צדק/טעה by the same person on the same agent+line+field replaces their earlier one; comments always add a row. For BankFileReader + טעה with a field (valueDate, amount, payerName, reference, lineType) and applyCorrection, it also corrects that BankLines field (correctedBy/At, flag cleared) and recomputes the batch extractedLineCount/extractedTotal/totalsCheck. Writes AgentFeedback (isTestFixture when the batch/line is test data) and BankLines/ImportBatches only for a correction.

bankLineId.description: BankLines.bankLineId; empty for the whole file

field.description: Field: valueDate, amount, payerName, reference, lineType, customer, invoices

applyCorrection.description: For BankFileReader + טעה: also correct the line field to valueCorrect

dryRun.description: When true, only report what would be written; nothing changes

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Correcting an extracted line**: Clicking "תיקון" on a line of today's bank file on the "תקבולים" screen
  Opens a short form (which field, the right value) that records the reader's mistake and corrects the line, recalculating the file's totals.
- **Clicking "נינה צדקה" or "נינה טעתה" under a checked record**: With an optional note
  Records whether Nina's identification and matching were right, to measure her accuracy. Nina does not reply.
